name: Photo Pocket
description: A badge with up to three photos tucked into a small pocket that rise and fan out on hover or focus.

props.name: images
props.description: Up to three image URLs. The first stands in the middle, in front. They are decorative, so describe the set in the label.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders the badge as a link. Without it the badge is a button.

props.name: rel
props.description: Link relationship, used with href. Defaults to "noreferrer" when target is "_blank".

props.name: size
props.description: Width of the pocket in pixels. The badge height and the photos scale with it.

props.name: lift
props.description: How far the photos rise out of the pocket when the badge is hovered or focused, in pixels.

props.name: spread
props.description: Sideways distance between neighbouring photos when fanned, in pixels.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Tilt of the outer photos when fanned, in degrees. At rest they lean 40% as far.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the badge. Other anchor or button props are passed through, including onClick and ref.
